version:
The Rocq Prover, version 9.2
compiled with OCaml 4.14.2
extraction: OCaml, exact Qc with arbitrary-precision inductive integers

oracle_tests.scope: Fraction comparisons are exact; PyTorch comparisons are sampled FP64 tolerance checks. No speed benchmark.

checks.name: scalar_linear_forward_and_all_gradients
checks.scope: Scalar polynomial identities; the finite-matrix theorem is checked by Rocq.

checks.name: scalar_gradient_update_preserved
checks.scope: Equality of two exact scalar parameter updates, not convergence.

checks.name: work_and_tape_guard
checks.scope: Nonnegative shape cost model, no hardware runtime guarantee.

checks.name: reject_unconditional_relu_contraction
checks.scope: Different activation masks invalidate unconditional reassociation; require the shared-mask theorem.

checks.name: reject_square_output_only_tape
checks.scope: Squaring erases sign needed for its pullback; Rocq also proves recovery impossible.

checks.name: reject_float_reassociation_without_error_contract
checks.scope: Finite FP32 inputs, with intermediate overflow on one path; exact rational proof does not imply bit equality.

checks.name: rank7_total_work_threshold
checks.scope: Uniform block-cost model including additions for forward and both gradients.

checks.name: winograd_total_work_threshold
checks.scope: Winograd saves nine additions relative to three ordinary Strassen products, with the same multiplication count.

checks.name: reject_multiplication_count_only_speed_claim
checks.scope: Seven-product scalar schedule saves multiplications while increasing total arithmetic.

checks.name: reject_rms_radial_null_with_positive_epsilon
checks.scope: With epsilon=1 and x=3, the radial derivative is nonzero; retain epsilon in derivative coefficients.

checks.name: normalized_rms_coefficient_rewrite
checks.scope: Exact coefficient identity; finite floating execution is tested separately.

checks.name: reject_scatter_overwrite_for_repeated_indices
checks.scope: Two gathered outputs referring to the same input require summation of both cotangents.

checks.name: affine_primal_and_all_gradients
checks.scope: One-coordinate affine differential pairing; finite shared-parameter sums are proved in Rocq.

checks.name: reject_cubic_scale_evaluation_at_zero
checks.scope: FP32 inverse scale is finite but its cube overflows; multiplying infinity by zero produces NaN.

broad_foundation.scope: Bounded mathematical reference qualification. No assertion of most-model speedup, global minimum memory, or GPU suitability.
